title: release(next): #21988 reds on the skills token ratchet at 18.0.0-next.0 (the prerelease version stamp adds 7 bytes to two SKILL.md files with 0 and 1 token of headroom)
body:
Maintainer-directed: 「21988 ci报错，你负责立卡并派发解决。」 / 「21988 是生成的，要修main 哦」 / 「我等着发版本，相关任务都是高优先级」 (this seat's session, 2026-10-13). Filing-gate category ①, a defect with a named landing point. It is the red that was hidden behind #23135's two roots.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` execution seat. It dispatches the fix once the maintainer picks the route below (the route needs the maintainer's word: the gate marks the loosening direction ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY).

**Dedupe:** issue search on this repo, closed included, with the words "skills token ratchet prerelease version stamp next SKILL.md ceiling". No hit for this class.

## What is measured

Measured by this seat's read-only probe on `63eb607ad1` (#21988's head) with PR #23155's two files overlaid; the main figures were re-read by the seat on `origin/main`.

- `Type Check · source gates` step 35 (`check:future-spec-major`) failed on #21988, so steps 36–41 were **skipped** and never ran on the v18 tree. With PR #23155 (now merged as `31a872d4e3`) step 35 is green, and step 37, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, is **red**:

```
✗ check-skills-token-ratchet: skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md is 5786 tokens; the ratchet ceiling is 5785 (over by 1). …
✗ check-skills-token-ratchet: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6129 tokens; the ratchet ceiling is 6128 (over by 1). …
✗ check-skills-token-ratchet: 2 of 64 published bundle file(s) failed their check.
```

- **Cause:** the version commit rewrites each SKILL.md frontmatter stamp from `version: "17.7.0"` to `version: "18.0.0-next.0"`, +7 bytes. The gate counts `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`.

| file | `main` bytes → tokens | ceiling (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) | headroom on `main` | at `18.0.0-next.0` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 23135 → 5784 | 5785 (`:323`) | 1 | 5786, red |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 24509 → 6128 | 6128 (`:341`) | 0 | 6129, red |

- The other SKILL.md files take the same 7 bytes with at least 6 tokens of headroom. A plain `18.0.0` stamp is the length of `17.7.0`, so the red lives only on the prerelease line; `-next.10` and above add 8 bytes.
- Steps 36, 38–41 and the five Test Core packages turbo never started on #21988 (`http-conformance`, `plugin-dev`, `plugin-pinyin-search`, `service-sms`, `knowledge-ragflow`) are green on the same tree.

## What done looks like

- #21988, refreshed from a `main` carrying the fix, has `Type Check · source gates` green (step 37 included) and every other check green or an expected skip.
- `main`'s own ratchet reading is unchanged or stricter; the route below says which.
